scientific_update: The frozen R27 bucket frontier is already wide very early: support reaches 48 by step 3 and 65 by step 4, while the retained live DAG is still only 435..443 nodes. Thereafter the frontier support narrows rather than widens, yet exact retained symbolic complexity accelerates sharply. From step 4 to step 24 support falls 65 to 47 while after-GC live nodes grow 443 to 514673, about 1162x; from step 16 to step 24 support falls 55 to 47 while live nodes grow about 46.5x. The fatal step uses only two factors with support 46. Therefore frontier cardinality and bucket factor count are not sufficient explanations: the next debt is accumulated exact Boolean message complexity carried on a still-wide frontier.
